knowledge.name: Fixed synthetic client and service snapshot
knowledge.detail: Bundled fictional clients, advisors, service requests, identity status, routing, ages, assets, and review dates support deterministic demos.

knowledge.name: Portfolio, target, and risk evidence
knowledge.detail: Packaged holdings, current and target allocations, risk profiles, retirement context, and contribution values support review preparation.

knowledge.name: Compliance controls and review rules
knowledge.detail: Fixed Reg BI, Form CRS, suitability, concentration, and senior-investor rules frame checkpoints without determining compliance.

intelligence_processing.name: Service intake and routing preparation
intelligence_processing.detail: Summarizes who is waiting, requested service, pending identity-control status, and proposed route without verification or assignment.

intelligence_processing.name: Advisor book review
intelligence_processing.detail: Consolidates client, advisor, risk, asset, age, retirement, and review-date evidence across the fixed synthetic book.

intelligence_processing.name: Portfolio allocation drift analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares current and target allocations and calculates maximum drift for a selected client without changing holdings.

intelligence_processing.name: Nonbinding discussion candidate preparation
intelligence_processing.detail: Surfaces illustrative allocation differences and rationale for advisor review, not recommendations, advice, or orders.

intelligence_processing.name: Suitability and compliance checkpoint review
intelligence_processing.detail: Relates risk, age, concentration, drift, Reg BI, Form CRS, and senior controls to required licensed and compliance review.

intelligence_processing.name: Banker-to-advisor handoff synthesis
intelligence_processing.detail: Drafts request, identity status, route, risk context, drift, and flags without transferring a case or contacting a client.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio conversational experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Provides natural-language access for branch bankers, advisors, advisory directors, and compliance officers in an unpublished Draft agent.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs FinancialAdvisorCopilotAgent through local Brainstem chat and UI endpoints with fixed synthetic evidence.

clients_user_interface.name: Evidence-first role review
clients_user_interface.detail: Separates recorded facts, calculations, discussion candidates, review checkpoints, and proposed handoff steps for human review.

management_reporting.name: Branch service intake report
management_reporting.detail: Reports synthetic clients, requests, pending identity checks, and proposed routing while confirming no service assignment occurred.

management_reporting.name: Client book and portfolio review
management_reporting.detail: Summarizes advisor ownership, risk profiles, assets, retirement context, holdings, targets, and calculated drift.

management_reporting.name: Suitability and compliance review
management_reporting.detail: Surfaces discussion candidates, client context, policy checkpoints, and senior-investor flags for licensed and compliance reviewers.

management_reporting.name: Draft advisor handoff report
management_reporting.detail: Compiles request, identity status, route, risk, portfolio drift, and flags while confirming no case transfer or outreach.

tools.name: Portable FinancialAdvisorCopilotAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent implements six read-only operations over bundled synthetic records with no credentials or side effects.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the portable tool and exposes conversational chat, streaming, health, and agent endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts two synthetic knowledge files and six operation skills; validated agents remain Draft and unpublished.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 banking or CRM context
tools.detail: Approved future seam for customer and service context; it is not connected in the current fixed synthetic package.

tools.name: Approved customer-identification workflow
tools.detail: Future authorization-gated seam for identity evidence; the package never verifies identity or clears a control.

tools.name: Approved portfolio and research services
tools.detail: Future least-privilege seam for governed evidence; current portfolio values and research context are fixed and synthetic.

tools.name: Microsoft 365
tools.detail: Approved preparation seam for governed documents and context; no file, record, approval, or communication is created.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams handoffs
tools.detail: Approved collaboration seam for reviewed handoffs; no message, assignment, approval, or case transfer is executed.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic evidence policy
supporting_features.detail: Uses only packaged fictional records and forbids browsing, enrichment, substitution, inference, or invention of missing facts.

supporting_features.name: Six deterministic operations
supporting_features.detail: Routes service intake, client review, portfolio summary, discussion candidates, compliance checks, and handoff preparation.

supporting_features.name: Fail-closed identifier handling
supporting_features.detail: Rejects unknown client identifiers instead of silently substituting another fictional record or fabricating evidence.

supporting_features.name: Suitability and compliance human gates
supporting_features.detail: Requires licensed-advisor and compliance review of objectives, risk tolerance, suitability, tax, disclosures, and consent.

supporting_features.name: No advice or execution boundary
supporting_features.detail: Prevents advice, suitability decisions, identity verification, account action, outreach, orders, transactions, and record changes.

supporting_features.name: Locked evidence and isolation validation
supporting_features.detail: Six persona-language cases passed with deterministic anchors and only FinancialAdvisorCopilotAgent loaded under strict isolation.

supporting_features.name: Draft and publication control
supporting_features.detail: Validated Copilot Studio agents remain unpublished, web search is removed, and publication requires separate confirmation.
